meta.title: 选对字体颜色，画面立马高级
meta.title_en: Right Font Color, Instantly Premium Frames

scenes.title_cn: 开场：看我头上放的红色文字，如果是黑…
scenes.title_en: Opening: look at the red text on my head—i…
scenes.context: 用直观例子引出颜色对比的概念。
sentences: 看看我头上放的红色文字吗？
See the red text on my head?
color contrast（颜色对比）
如果是黑色的，那就没有那么酷了，那就是颜色对比。
If it were black, it wouldn't be as cool—that's color contrast.
that's color contrast（这就是颜色对比）
scenes.speak: See the red text on my head? If it were black, it wouldn't be as cool—that's color contrast.

scenes.title_cn: 黄色在蓝色上很漂亮，但黑色或者灰色就…
scenes.title_en: Yellow on blue looks beautiful, but black …
scenes.context: 互补色对比出彩，低对比颜色平庸。
sentences: 黄色在蓝色上，真漂亮。
Yellow on blue—beautiful.
yellow on blue（黄配蓝）
但是黑色或者灰色，那就一般吧。
But black or gray is just average.
just average（一般般）
scenes.speak: Yellow on blue—beautiful. But black or gray is just average.

scenes.title_cn: 有时候文字颜色会毁掉画面。在这种情况…
scenes.title_en: Sometimes the text color ruins the frame. …
scenes.context: 拿不准时白色最稳，配合降饱和。
sentences: 有时候文字颜色会毁掉画面。
Sometimes the text color ruins the frame.
ruin the frame（毁掉画面）
在这种情况下就用白色，通过降低文字颜色的饱和度，你可以达到完美的搭配效果。
In that case, use white—by desaturating the text color, you get a perfect match.
perfect match（完美搭配）
scenes.speak: Sometimes the text color ruins the frame. In that case, use white—by desaturating the text color, you get a perfect match.

scenes.title_cn: 结尾：如果你喜欢这种内容，关注我，我…
scenes.title_en: Ending: if you like this kind of content, …
sentences: 如果你喜欢这种内容，关注我，我会教你。
If you like this kind of content, follow me and I'll teach you.
follow me（关注我）
scenes.speak: If you like this kind of content, follow me and I'll teach you.

practice: Red on my head pops; black would look flat.
Use white and desaturate the text color.
pitfalls: Use any text color you like.
Choose a color that contrasts with the background.
字体颜色要与背景形成对比，否则不酷。
Pick gray for a safe look.
Pick a complementary color like yellow on blue.
黑灰一般般，互补色才出彩。
Stick to a loud color on busy frames.
Use white and desaturate when color ruins the frame.
画面复杂时白色加降饱和最稳。
shifts: 用 text color（文字颜色）、color contrast（颜色对比）、complementary（互补色）
footer_notes: 转录基于图文实录完整口播。已校正：红色文字、颜色对比、黄色在蓝色上、黑色灰色一般、文字颜色毁画面、白色、降饱和、完美搭配等。
